name: sw-venture-website
description: Responsive SW Venture parent website with React and Node.js/Express API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.check-db: node -e "import('./backend/src/contact-store.js').then(async m => { await m.initialiseStore(); const l = await m.getLeads(); console.log('\n📊 Leads in Neon Database (' + l.length + ' total):'); console.table(l.slice(0, 10).map(r => ({ ID: r.leadNumber, Name: r.fullName, Email: r.email, Service: r.serviceRequired, Type: r.leadType, Status: r.status }))); await m.closeStore(); })"
